title: "Accelerated MS (4+1)"
subtitle: "Your master's in one extra year, for students from UMass and the Five Colleges"
---

Earn your **MS in Biostatistics in just one additional year** after your bachelor's degree. If you're an undergraduate at **UMass Amherst, Amherst College, Hampshire, Mount Holyoke or Smith**, you can start graduate courses in your senior year and count some of them toward both degrees.

## Who is eligible?

- Undergraduates at **UMass and the Five Colleges**
- You **apply in the fall of your junior year**
- You have room in your senior-year schedule for graduate courses that don't count toward your undergraduate degree

## How it works

| When | What you do |
|---|---|
| **Junior year, fall** | Apply to the 4+1 |
| **Senior year** | Take graduate courses (typically 6–12 credits); up to 6 count toward both degrees |
| **The +1 year** | Finish the remaining MS credits (typically 18–24) and your project or thesis |

Contact Nick Reich ([nick@umass.edu](mailto:nick@umass.edu)). See also the [official 4+1 page](https://www.umass.edu/public-health-sciences/academics/41-accelerated-ms-biostatistics).
